NgraceChangeDesignContext.Rationale:
Four dedicated attempt-pair regression tests read the repository's real archive as their input: they name concrete publisher bundles, enumerate the current archive population, embed a frozen authoring-time membership list, and drive the real CLI against one publisher bundle's recorded ledger. The tests are current-behavior regressions and do not need the archive as a corpus. Anchoring them there makes their input depend on publisher bundle names, a denominator that only shrinks, and archived artifact formats.
The isolated slice is: replace those four inputs with explicitly constructed synthetic current fixtures, directly validate the selected synthetic spec, plan, and run-ledger, keep a meaningful silent case with a real recorded fail/pass pair and changed source digests, and preserve the positive real-CLI warning on equal non-artifact source digests together with the adjacent warning/error exit controls. All four original input obligations are replaced and their behavioral criteria and counterweights retained; the number and organization of replacement `it` blocks are not prescribed. The future implementation writes exactly `src/review/core.test.ts`, owned by `M-REVIEW` and verified by `V-M-REVIEW`.
The behavioral counterweights carried by the replaced obligations are preserved. The denominator-shrink counterweight (the old frozen-membership assertion) becomes explicit fixture presence plus a nonzero audited pair count. The detector-suppression counterweight (the old positive warning) becomes a real-CLI warning over a synthetic bundle with equal digests. The silent case asserts both the live and the retired code are absent, so retired-code absence is not lost when the corpus enumeration is removed. The no-archive-input rule is scoped to the replacement coverage for these four inputs; the other process-audit tests this slice leaves in place still select repository archived bundles and are unchanged.

Alternatives.Alternative: Variant 1 (chosen): isolate only the four dedicated pair-regression inputs. One implementation file, one audit contract, existing fixture helpers suffice, and the positive warning remains. This does not complete the separate process-audit/status/context/calibration input boundaries, which remain separate prerequisite slices.

Variant 2 (rejected): convert all selected repository-root review callers in `src/review/core.test.ts`. It removes more publisher-input dependencies in one delivery, but it spans other process-audit contracts, needs more fixture setup, and combines independently verifiable audit behaviors with this small input contract, increasing correction risk.

Keep reading the archive but assert membership more loosely. Rejected: a denominator that only shrinks cannot answer whether the audit actually looked, and any read of the real archive keeps the input coupled to publisher bundle names and historical formats.

DeferredDecisions.Decision: The remaining publisher readers (other process-audit tests, status/context/calibration inputs, global consumer archive policy) are separate prerequisite slices of publisher-input isolation. This bundle is one dependency slice, not a claim that the whole program is finished.
Whether any future archive-compatibility exemption or global consumer policy is needed is deferred. This slice must not add one.

Scenarios.Scenario: A synthetic archived bundle records a fail event and a pass event whose non-artifact source digests differ. The shipped validators report zero issues for the selected spec, plan, and run-ledger. Reviewing the bundle yields zero live and zero retired attempt-pair findings, and the audit reports it ran over one pair.

A synthetic archived bundle records a fail event and a pass event whose non-artifact source digests are equal. Driving the real CLI exits 0 and the JSON names exactly one `review.attempt-pair-identical-tree` warning at the declared anchor, under the synthetic archive path, with a 16-hex finding ID, over one audited pair.

A warning-only synthetic project exits 0 and names the live warning; a synthetic project carrying a current error exits 1. The replacement coverage for the four dedicated pair-regression inputs reads no repository `.ngrace/changes/archive/` contents as input; the other process-audit tests this slice leaves in place are unchanged.
